rows.en:
(Okay, classes are over,
so I guess I'll head home soon.)

Hey, \p.
What do you think you're doing, heading home?
Huh? Was there something, Gary-sensei?

You've completely forgotten, haven't you...
Your career plan survey is due today.
Ah!? Oh, right...!
I'm sorry... Gary-sensei.

Geez, I bet you lost the form too.
It's too much of a pain, so just tell me out loud.
rows.notes: koutou (the script writes it with the wrong kanji): answer orally.

rows.en:
You're only a second-year, so it doesn't have
to be all that clear-cut a career path.

Let's see...
Join a military like the New U.N. Forces or S.M.S.
and take the path of a "soldier"...
rows.notes: gunjin rendered "soldier" throughout this scene, minkanjin "civilian".

rows.en:
Or stay out of the military, aim for college,
and take the path of a "civilian"...
rows.notes: Shared with scd_fes_813 where Hilda says it; works for both.

rows.en: So, which'll it be?
rows.notes: Dotchika erabe? Gary asking the player to pick.

rows.en: (That seems way too rough-and-ready, though...)
Uh, well, I'd say...
rows.notes: Male only (both occurrences); female twin is c22298.

rows.en: I want the "soldier" path
I want the "civilian" path

All right, the "soldier" path it is.
I'll fill in the form and hand it in for you,
so don't worry.
And don't you forget to hand it in next time.
Yes, sir... I'm sorry...

(A career plan, huh...
I wonder what's waiting for me in the future?)
rows.notes: x6, male in scd_com_510 and scd_fes_813.

rows.en:
All right, the "civilian" path it is.
I'll fill in the form and hand it in for you,
so don't worry.

Okay, "soldier" works for you, right?
There, decided!
rows.notes: Gary decides for the player in this branch.

rows.en:
Call it a hunch, but I think you're cut out to be
a soldier. So I'm putting down "soldier."
Got a problem with that?
N-no, that's fine...

(I was going to say "soldier" anyway,
so it's not really a problem, but...)

Well, like I said, you're still only a second-year.
You've still got time to think about what
you want to do. Give it some real thought.
I'm sorry...
Uh, well, I'd say...

(A career plan, huh...
I wonder what's waiting for me in the future?)

(Well, the new term starts tomorrow, so I guess
it was just right for shaking off the summer daze.)

(Yeah! I'm about to be a second-year too,
so I'd better get my head in the game!)

Hey, \p.
What's got you all tensed up?
rows.notes: Katahiji haru: being stiff/tense; shared male/female.

rows.en:
Hey, Alto.
Starting tomorrow, we're getting underclassmen too,
so I figured I should act more like an upperclassman.

That's stupid.
Who needs underclassmen anyway?

What are you talking about, Alto?
We're finally getting underclassmen.
You should take them under your wing.
I couldn't care less.

I bet before long...
you'll have underclassmen adoring you, like
"Big Sis Alto, you're so dreamy~!"
rows.notes: Alto onee-sama: kinship word translated ("Big Sis Alto"), schoolgirl-crush joke at Alto, who played female roles.

rows.en: (I could actually see that happening with Alto...)
Michael...! You bastard!
rows.notes: Alto calls him Mihaeru: "Michael" per glossary.

rows.en:
Geez, Princess Alto really
can't take a joke, can she?
Joke or not, don't call me princess!
Honestly, those two never change, do they?
Haha, yeah.

Still, I've been watching Alto and Michel go
through the same back-and-forth for almost
a year now...

Looking back on it like this,
this year really felt like it flew by.

That probably just means
it was a really full year.
Yeah, maybe...

But I think that's because I had Alto
and you guys around...
Seriously, thanks for this past year...

Geez, what kind of embarrassing stuff
are you saying, \p?
Haha, it is a little embarrassing.
How can you say that without even blushing...

Wh-what?!
Here I go to the trouble of thanking you guys...
Haha, don't get so down about it.
Anyway, we're counting on you from here on too.
Please keep looking out for us.
......I'm counting on you.
rows.notes: Alto, curt: "yoroshiku tanomu" given its subject.

rows.en:
Yeah!
And I'm counting on you guys too!

(I hope I can spend another fun year with Alto
and the others, now that I'm a second-year.)

(Still, today's joint training
didn't feel all that tough...)

(I guess this past year has toughened me up
in body and mind too.)

(Well, the new term starts tomorrow, so I guess
it was just right for shaking off the summer daze.)

(Yeah! I'm about to be a second-year too,
so I'd better get my head in the game!)

Saotome-kun.
Starting tomorrow, we're getting underclassmen too,
so I figured I should act more like an upperclassman.

(I could totally see that happening
with Saotome-kun...)
Haha, yeah.

Still, I've been watching Saotome-kun and
Michel-kun go through the same back-and-forth
for almost a year now...

Looking back on it like this,
this year really felt like it flew by.
Yeah, maybe...

But I think that's because I had Saotome-kun
and you guys around...
Seriously, thank you for this past year...

Wh-what?!
Here I go to the trouble of thanking you guys...

Yeah!
And I'm counting on you guys too!

(I hope I can spend another fun year with
Saotome-kun and the others, now that
I'm a second-year.)

(I guess this past year has toughened me up
in body and mind too.)

uncertain: c22284/c22285 (choices): gunjin / minkanjin as 'soldier' / 'civilian', quoted as in the Japanese brackets.
c22308: 'Alto onee-sama' rendered 'Big Sis Alto' (kinship word translated per brief).
